prompt_en: Create a natural editorial photograph of one adult woman at a terraced hillside bus interchange on an overcast morning after rain. Use the attached portrait as her facial appearance and hair reference: retain the softly oval face, dark brown eyes, full natural lips, and long loose dark wavy hair. She wears a charcoal coat, cream knit top, dark trousers and ankle boots. She pauses on a broad concrete stair landing, both boot soles resting flat on the same level surface, her left hand lightly wrapped around the waist-high metal handrail beside her left hip while her right hand holds a small canvas tote beside her right thigh. Her torso turns slightly toward the camera. Both forearms and the hand-to-rail contact remain visible. The rail continues down the adjacent stairs, leaving clear standing space around her feet. Show her full figure within a spacious architectural view. A foreground drainage grate meets the landing edge; the stairs rise behind her to a steel and glass bus shelter; a retaining wall and hillside apartment facades occupy successively deeper planes. Concrete stair joints, tile paving seams and shelter posts retain consistent perspective and human scale. Rain darkens sheltered concrete unevenly, with a shallow puddle beside the drain and small scuffs along the handrail. Glass panels transmit the structures behind them and catch the pale sky. Soft overhead daylight reaches her face and the surrounding construction with matching direction and restrained contrast. At the landing, a drain cover fits flush within the walking surface; along the retaining wall, a service pipe follows the wall on visible supports; the fixtures leave a continuous passage through the space. The shelter base has broad matte concrete shading beside a narrow steel highlight and transparent glass carrying a pale sky reflection. Her face and handrail contact are crisp, shelter posts remain recognizable at middle distance, and apartment windows soften progressively farther uphill. These material responses and the depth of focus belong to the same continuous landing-to-shelter view. Frame horizontally at chest height with a 35mm lens, placing her just right of center.
negative_en: warped walls, low resolution, illustration look, impossible perspective, fake-looking background, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, 3D render look
